title: Otori Emu — Eyes On Other Troupes〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Diner

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Movie, movie♪ It's gonna be so goodie♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's been making headlines with all the powerhouse young actors that are in it. I've also been looking forward to seeing it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But we still have a bit of time before it begins, so why don't we stay here for a little longer?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, can we go shopping afterwards? I wanna buy a new pair of training shoes!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There's also a book I wanna buy, so I'd like to stop by the mall.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We'll see the movie, go shopping...
And have ourselves a relaxing day off.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, we have so much time on our hands now that our away training is over.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We were so busy with rehearsals and assignments that even our holidays ended up being fairly chaotic.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But we've definitely learned a lot.
So, I'm glad that we've been able to train with all these different troupes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and we need to thank them, as well as Emu's brothers, again for giving us these wonderful opportunities.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I hope we get to keep visiting different troupes and continue to grow together.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Different troupes...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, where do you guys wanna go next?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... That's a tough question.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Each troupe possesses different strengths and qualities.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Personally, I think it'd be nice if we could visit one with a lot of focus on singing...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's a good option! As for me, I'd say dancing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: By learning a variety of dance styles, we could expand the breadth of our shows!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm thinking... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A troupe that's all dressed as mascots!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Mascots?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, there are troupes out there that put on those kinds of shows.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Exactly☆ Those types of shows sometimes don't involve much speaking...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But you can tell exactly what's going on in the story just based on the way the characters move. I think that's really amazing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Telling a story only through gestures and pantomime is easier said than done.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And those costumes really limit your range of motion.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We could gain some good experience by learning how to get through to an audience under such conditions.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: See what I mean♪ Oh, also!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Umm... Im...? Immer...? Emergency?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There's an emergency now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Were you trying to say immersive theatre?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Rui, that's it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How'd you make that leap...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Immersive theatre involves having the audience actively participate in a show, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. As the name suggests, the audience becomes immersed in the world of the show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Some shows have the audience walk around and converse with the actors, or even help them move the story along.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Things can change depending on what they say and do too, right?♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Things can change... That sounds a lot like improvisational theatre.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've heard of those before, but actually performing in one sounds rather challenging.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You'd have to memorize multiple scenarios and adapt based on what actually happens.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I feel like I'd get my lines for the different happenings all mixed up...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And performing alongside the audience means...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not only do you have to know how to deal with the unexpected, how you rope in the audience and get them excited will also be important.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right. That sounds like a good workout for our improvisation muscles.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And you'd learn how to stay in character regardless of the situation.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
True.
Thinking about it that way, there are still so many places we could learn from.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What's wrong, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Keisuke just sent me a message.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? It seems he sent it to us all.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's see... He wants us to visit your house next Sunday so he can tell us something.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
What could it be?
Is there anything you can tell us, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, I have no idea...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I have a good feeling about it for some reason!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, it'll be something we can look forward to while we wait for the week to pass.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup☆
